attchmntText: Outcome of Board Meeting under Regulations 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations")
voiceSummary: Nalwa Sons Investments Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, during a Board meeting held on 12th November, 2026. The company appointed Mr. Ajay Mittal as Chief Compliance Officer with effect from November 20, 2026, for a period of 5 years. Mr. Mittal will continue as Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel. For the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 4,207.71 lakhs and a profit for the period of 3,051.92 lakhs. Total comprehensive income for the period was 23,349.30 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 59.42. The statutory auditors conducted a review of the results.
